brush.line: Brushes loose stone away. Slow, never cracks.

pick.line: Chips a cell and the one behind it. Fast; cracks the fossil if it reaches it.

blast.line: Blasts a round patch of crust. Quick and wide; cracks any fossil in it.

slice.line: Slices one layer off flat across the slab; cracks the fossil where the layer crosses it.

hoover.line: Draws out loose stone round a cell. Never cracks.

toll.line: The fossil's outline rings through the stone for a moment. Three a slab.

silhouette.line: Holds the plate to the slab: the creature's shape drawn faintly on its face to aim by.
